content.title: Ireland's Rugby Union Victory Against South Africa
content.caption: Ireland secured a hard-fought 20-17 win over South Africa in Dublin, marking a significant improvement in their recent performance.

slides.heading: Ireland's Rugby Union Victory Against South Africa
slides.text: Ireland secured a hard-fought 20-17 win over South Africa in Dublin, marking a significant improvement in their recent performance.

slides.heading: Recent Struggles
slides.text: Ireland had been struggling with six consecutive losses to South Africa, New Zealand, and France.

slides.heading: Key Details
slides.text: Ireland's win over South Africa was their biggest victory of recent years, having not beaten one of the three teams above them in the rankings since the summer of 2024.
